This moss is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in freshwater banks and shores, and is best known throughout Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

To obtain its properties, it is used by direct application.

Applied as a remedy, this moss reduces fevers.
